orientation: outside half: rotation 0, outward is UP: nozzles point up into space; the exhaust glow overhangs above the frame (see glow.offset); the bottom 4px are the flange onto the outer wall face
notes: Scrapper Clans "Double Kick", a hull mount (outward is up): two big mismatched bells welded side by side, a dented grey one and a rust one with a grey patch, a welded cross plate with tape, and a small strapped tank; inside the Kickjet core with a second ribbed motor, taped hatches, a rusty feed pipe and wires between the boxes. Damaged: the dent is on fire, the rust bell lost a patch bolt and its flame sputters, the tank strap is snapped and it weeps fuel, sparks in the core. Disabled: both bells bent over at their necks, the weld between them cracked, the tank slid off and split, the core dead. THIS FILE: the OUTSIDE half (nozzles, in space against the outer wall face; its bottom 4px are the flange onto the wall). It is never destroyed, only disabled (bent, dead, fixable).
